messages:
evan: Quick preflight / go-no-go roster for the cut on Wed 2026-03-25. Need to align across timezones and confirm smoke owners. Please RSVP with one of the slots below and include your timezone. Use :white_check_mark: to claim a role.

Slots:
- Slot A: 07:00-09:00 UTC (APAC-friendly)
- Slot B: 14:00-16:00 UTC (EMEA-friendly)
- Slot C: 21:00-23:00 UTC (US-friendly)

Short agenda (target 35m):
```
1) Roll call + infra health (5m)
2) Smoke canary results (10m)
3) Blockers & unblock plan (10m)
4) Go/no-go decision (5m)
5) Post-cut monitoring handoff (5m)
```

Roles to claim: canary-owner, rollback-owner, infra-oncall, docs-owner. If you can't join live, assign a delegate in-thread.

sana: Slot B for me (CET). I'll take canary-owner. :white_check_mark:

leo: US-PT here, slot C preferred. I'll be rollback-owner. ping @kim if we need infra help.

kim: slot C works for me. I can be infra-oncall but need a quick handover on the new autoscale config — @evan can you share the runbook link?

evan: @kim runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscale-cut — added notes about expected metrics and thresholds. Quick checklist snippet: 
```
- checkpoint db backups ✅
- freeze schema migrations
- traffic ramp plan
- alert thresholds confirmed
```

tara: Remote APAC, Slot A. I can own docs and run the smoke test checklist. I'll post the smoke prompts in #qa-prior ~T-90.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: go/no-go meeting created for 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC (Slot B) — thread pinned. Use `/release rsvp <slot>` to update your RSVP.

sana: small ask — can we have a quiet T-30 async check (15m) for last-minute issues? I can compile notes if people post by T-60.

evan: yes — good call. I'll open a short preflight doc and drop the link here at T-48. Thanks all :rocket:
